other_reading: Remove only rows that are exact duplicates of another row across all columns, which on these files removes nothing because no two rows are identical.
reading_followed: Within Sheet1, delete every row whose Product repeats an earlier row's Product, keeping the first occurrence of each product in original order, so that 15 rows remain.
notes: The Product-column reading was chosen because it is the common hand-performed 'remove duplicates on Product' action and it changes the file, whereas the whole-row reading is a no-op. Date Time and Web Site values of kept rows are not checked by any must predicate.
